Hi all — attaching the draft agenda and baseline pre-read. I recommend a 75-minute session: 45m walkthrough + 30m Q&A + optional 15m breakout with your infra folks if deeper config work is needed.

Draft agenda (attached PDF: redwood-arch-review-agenda.pdf):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) High-level deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) (10m)
3) Integration patterns & request flow (including KV cache behavior) (15m)
4) Security & compliance (networking, audit logs, KMS) (10m)
5) Performance/latency expectations and scaling (10m)
6) Q&A + next steps + action items (15m)

Pre-read (links attached):
- System diagram (system-diagram-v2.png) — shows routing, KV cache, and fallbacks
- Pre-read doc (pre-read.md) — short runbook + sample network ACLs

Notes for the session: please have someone on the infra side available to discuss firewall/VPC peering. We'll include a short checklist for readiness.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2B3C4-redwood-acme-arch
